RYU-GRAMMAR.title: Satoru Hanazono (2014), 日本語教育の方法論を応用した初級沖縄語教科書について, pp.119–120
RYU-GRAMMAR.supports: Grammar charts: genitive nu, nominal positive/negative predicates, polite past light verb, attributives, resultant state, destination nkai, and comparison yaka. PDF pages 122–123 (zero based).

RYU-NINJAL.title: NINJAL 沖縄語辞典 (1963; revised 2001), official data
RYU-NINJAL.supports: Independently inspected dictionary entries: ?aa=juN p.99, biCi p.132, Cika=juN p.150, ?ira=buN p.258, nagasaN p.404, na=juN p.406, nuku=sjuN p.425, sjuN p.492, tiiCi p.517. They establish lexical senses and verb classes; sentence wording is this review’s composition.

RYU-USE.title: Haisai, original Okinawan essay うちなあぐちの生命力
RYU-USE.supports: Authorial Okinawan prose uses 使（ちか）ゆるくとぅ. Supports short-a attributive chikayuru, unlike held chikaayuru.

RYU-CAPABILITY.title: Haisai, original parallel Japanese/Okinawan lesson 59
RYU-CAPABILITY.supports: Parallel clause expresses inability using a nominalized action followed by ないびらん; this differs from the prohibition construction built on the conjunctive.
